The heading's size: `regular` or `compact`. Not set, or any other value, draws regular, the heading at
`--ocelle-font-size-2xl`; `compact` draws it at `--ocelle-font-size-xl`. Reflected.

declarations.name: OcellePersonalRail

members.name: label
members.description:
The name of the navigation landmark, trimmed, used while the host has no `aria-label`; empty or whitespace-only
counts as none, and the landmark is then unnamed. Not reflected.

members.name: orientation
members.description:
The layout direction, set by the page or a shell: `vertical` (a column) or `horizontal` (a row that wraps). Not
set, or any other value, is vertical; the element never changes it itself. Reflected.

declarations.description: A personal rail: a navigation landmark holding the page's primary items and a bottom group, on the chrome.

declarations.name: OcelleProgress

members.name: value
members.description:
The current amount, from 0 to `max`: below 0 counts as 0, above `max` as `max`. Unset, `null`, an empty or
whitespace-only attribute, or a value that is not a finite number makes the bar indeterminate. Not reflected.

members.name: max
members.description: The maximum. Unset, not a finite number, or 0 or less counts as 100. Not reflected.

members.name: valueText
members.description:
Words for the current value, for example "7 of 12", exposed (and shown with `show-label`) while the bar is
determinate, as given. Unset lets the platform announce the value. Not reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name, as text (no rich label). A bar needs a name: set `label`, or a host `aria-label`, which
overrides it. To name a bar after a nearby heading, pass the heading's text. Not reflected.

members.name: showLabel
members.description:
Shows the label as text above the bar (beside it in compact), and the value text while determinate. Unset hides
both; the name and value are exposed either way.

members.name: size
members.description: `compact` is a thin bar with the label beside it. Unset, or any other value, gives the default size. Reflected.

members.name: ground
members.description:
`tinted` draws the track's boundary in the accent-strong colour, for a bar on an inset, accent-low, hover or state
ground. Unset is for the canvas, sheet, pane, panel, inspector and rail grounds. Reflected.

declarations.description: A progress bar: determinate with a `value`, indeterminate without one. Name it with `label`.

cssParts.name: track
cssParts.description: The track, the full inline size of the bar.

cssParts.name: fill

slots.name: heading
slots.description: The page's own heading element (`h1` to `h6`), drawn with the header's heading style; its level is the page's.

slots.name: eyebrow
slots.description: A short label above the heading, drawn with the eyebrow style; not rendered in the eyebrow variant.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Supporting text under the heading; not rendered in the eyebrow variant.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Controls at the inline end of the heading's first line, wrapping under the heading when they do not fit beside it.

declarations.name: OcelleSectionHeader

members.name: size
members.description:
The heading's size: `regular` or `compact`. Not set, or any other value, draws regular, or compact when the
header is in a compact card's `header` slot; a valid value wins over the card. No effect in the eyebrow variant.
Reflected.

members.name: variant
members.description:
`eyebrow` draws the heading with the eyebrow style and renders neither the eyebrow nor the description slot;
`default`, not set or any other value draws the default heading style. Reflected.
